question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — ARTIST Act (S 254)
plain_language: This bill prohibits states from imposing bans on marine mammal products produced by Alaska Natives. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Tribal Trust Land Homeownership Act (S 723)
bill_title: Tribal Trust Land Homeownership Act of 2025
plain_language: This bill sets forth requirements for the processing of a proposed residential leasehold mortgage, business leasehold mortgage, land mortgage, or right-of-way document by the Bureau of Indian Affairs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

question: Passage, Objections of the President To The Contrary Notwithstanding — Miccosukee Reserved Area Amendments Act (H R 504)
plain_language: This bill expands the Miccosukee Reserved Area to include the part of Everglades National Park known as Osceola Camp and directs the Interior Department to protect structures there from flooding. The President vetoed it, so this was a vote to override the veto, which needs two-thirds. A Yea votes to override; a Nay sustains the veto.
